a.speaker: The West Hills
a.text: The hill hospital is on the far side of the West Hills. The highway tunnel is a dark throat full of dead cars and people walking with their hands on the wall. The light rail tunnel beside it is darker and three miles long.

options.text: Walk the rail tunnel in the dark. Shorter, and nobody else is in there.
effects: You walked the dark rail tunnel under the West Hills.

options.text: Take the old road over the top through Sylvan.
Go the long way round by Cornell Road. Two more watches, nobody on it.

tunnel_bad.speaker: The rail tunnel
tunnel_bad.text: Halfway in you lose the wall, then your nerve. You come out the way you went in an hour later, shaking, and take the long road. (+8 Strain, a watch lost.)

sylvan.speaker: Sylvan
sylvan.text: At the top of the hill three men have a dead minivan across the road and are going through a stopped car's trunk while its owner sits on the curb. One has a pry bar. One has a knife. The third looks at you and says, "Bag. Shoes. Keep walking."

options.text: "Three of you, one tired person with nothing worth a fight. You don't want this."
effects: You talked your way through the Sylvan carjackers.

options.text: Hand over the bag and walk on.
effects: You paid the Sylvan carjackers with your bag.

fight_now.speaker: Sylvan
fight_now.text: "Wrong answer." The one with the pry bar steps in.

talked.speaker: Sylvan
talked.text: The leader holds your eyes for a long moment, then jerks his head. You walk past. The car's owner walks with you, very fast.

paid.speaker: Sylvan
paid.text: They take the bag and the two days of food in it and let you pass. It is the cheapest thing that could have happened. It doesn't feel cheap.
